cycles.method: Worst event: one sequencer step of all 16 tracks. Instruction counts per detour call under ot_emu --mkii (the gesture, MIDI and global-change run on STEPTPM; entry to the stock instruction it returns to, replayed stock instructions included). static: the per-call maximums summed, 8 x (95 + 186) + 8 x (98 + 84) = 3,704 instructions; measured: the per-call medians summed, about 2,360 instructions; both at a 32 cycles/instruction allowance (Play Modes' convention), not measured chip timing. The LED pass is a separate event of at most 658 instructions. Budget: one step at 300 BPM and 2X track speed, 25 ms at 264 MHz. See TESTING.md.

load.method: cfmeter.py on 105 s USB captures of T8 (CF METER on T8 FX2, BURN/MEM/DBRN 0) on the contributor's MKII, 22 Oct 2026, under the same MIDI flood into DIN MIDI IN (USB-MIDI to DIN interface): 999 three-byte messages/s (note-on, note-off, CC 1) on channel 16, which no track listens to, plus 250 BPM clock, START, STOP at 50 s and START at 55 s, for 90 s (1,099 messages/s, 3,097 bytes/s, 0 send errors). Stock = OCTABAM11 (USB, CF METER, CF METER IDLE, stock effects but DARK REV), module = OCTABAM10 (the same plus TRACK PATTERNS), both octabam 05d8701c; the unit followed the flood's clock and transport. Longest frame interrupt: the worst 2 s cycle; idle: the mean over 51-52 cycles (about 10 s before the flood included); no cycle exceeded the 362.8 us frame in either take. Differences between the takes: M1-M4 were given trigs on every step before the OCTABAM10 take, and only that take had TRACK PATTERNS gestures (one cycle at 3.3 % idle during them). Without a flood (300 BPM, 15 tracks on every step, 120 s): 17.58 % vs 17.78 % idle with every track following, 16.10 % with eight overrides and gestures. The same flood on T1-T7's channels instead saturates the control image too (0.0 % idle, frame interrupt to 417 us): stock behaviour, see TESTING.md.

stress.droppedExplanation: Hangs 0: in the OCTABAM10 take the unit's clock output kept running throughout (longest gap 126 ms), the CF METER readout never stopped, idle stayed above 0 % in every 2 s cycle and no frame interrupt exceeded the frame; the contributor reports the sequencer playing and M1-M4 sending during the flood. Stuck notes unmeasured: the MIDI tracks' notes do not reach the USB port (octabam's USB module mirrors midi_send and realtime bytes only; on the unit only clock came back, with or without the flood and on internal or external clock), and the USB-MIDI interface's DIN input received nothing from the unit's MIDI OUT, so no note-off accounting after STOP, the Part change or the channel change was possible. Drops unmeasured: the module takes no MIDI input, and the unit gives no echo of what it received. An earlier USB MIDI flood saturated both images (octabam's issue sambanks/octabam#856, see TESTING.md).
